create_container_definition: create a ContainerDefinition dataclass instance with id, image, cpu, memory, entry_point, environment, and task_role_id fields
review_container_definition_fields: review the ContainerDefinition dataclass fields including id, image, cpu, memory, entry_point, environment, task_role_id, and optional tags
summarize_container_definition: summarize the ContainerDefinition dataclass which represents an ECS container with resource limits and environment configuration
refactor_container_definition_tags: refactor the ContainerDefinition to add or modify optional tags dictionary field with a default empty dict
test_container_definition_instantiation: test instantiating a ContainerDefinition with required fields and verify the default empty tags dictionary is created
